tests.description: Two simultaneous touches independently drag the two paddles, and releasing one leaves the other under control.
tests.name: Independent two-touch paddle control
source: harness.assert(moved1.centerX > p1.centerX + 50 && moved1.centerY < p1.centerY - 30, 'Player 1 moves right and up toward its own touch');
harness.assert(moved2.centerX < p2.centerX - 50 && moved2.centerY > p2.centerY + 30, 'Player 2 moves left and down toward its own touch');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('P2TouchActive')?.value === true, 'Player 2 remains controlled after Player 1 releases');
harness.assert(after.centerY < before.centerY - 40, 'Player 2 continues following its touch independently');

tests.description: A puck entering each goal awards exactly one point to the opposing player, and a fresh puck appears between goals.
tests.name: Both nets award the correct player
source: harness.setObjectPosition(puck.id, nets[0].x + nets[0].width - puck.width, nets[0].centerY - puck.height / 2);
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Player1Score')?.value === 0, 'Left goal does not score for Player 1');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Player2Score')?.value === 1, 'Left goal scores one point for Player 2');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Player1Score')?.value === 0 && harness.getSceneVariable('Player2Score')?.value === 1, 'Left goal does not repeatedly award points');
harness.assert(!!next && next.id !== puck.id, 'A fresh puck is spawned after the left goal');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Player1Score')?.value === 1, 'Right goal scores one point for Player 1');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Player2Score')?.value === 1, 'Right goal does not add a point for Player 2');
harness.assert(harness.getSceneVariable('Player1Score')?.value === 1 && harness.getSceneVariable('Player2Score')?.value === 1, 'Right goal does not repeatedly award points');

eventsFunctionsExtensions.name: PanelSpriteButton
description: A button that can be used for menus and most labelled buttons of a game. The button can be customized with a background for each state and a label. It handles user interactions and a simple condition can be used to check if it is clicked.
There are ready-to-use buttons in the asset-store [menu buttons pack](https://editor.gdevelop.io/?initial-dialog=asset-store&asset-pack=menu-buttons-menu-buttons).

changelog.breaking: - Buttons now use "variants", allowing easy swapping of their visual aspect. You will have to make some adjustments to existing buttons in your project. Follow this [migration documentation](https://wiki.gdevelop.io/gdevelop5/objects/custom-objects-prefab-template/migrate-to-variants/) to do these changes.

eventsFunctionsExtensions.shortDescription: Limit max movement and rotation speed for forces-based or Physics 2D.
description: Limit the maximum movement and rotation speed of an object from forces or the 2D Physics behavior.
- Add the behavior that matches the method used to move the object (forces or physics)
- Set the maximum speed value in the behavior properties
- This only affects movement caused by forces or physics behavior
- This may not affect movement caused by other behaviors (platformer, top-down, draggable, etc)
